title: Theo and the Veil
author: Cyrus Joubert
blurb: Astrid Pemberton, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
